title: Chapter 11 Acid Rain
content:
Chapter 11 Acid Rain

After a tiring day, he returned to the shelter, drank a few sips of boiling water, grilled two fish, and ate them deliciously.

At this moment, there was a loud "dong" sound, which made Wang Shuo's hand holding the fish tremble.

This loud noise not only did not scare Wang Shuo, but instead made him feel happy.

He said to himself: "The big guy finally took the bait!"

He quickly ran to the trap and saw a huge crocodile about 5 meters in the pit, struggling in the trap.

Its whole body was covered with metal-like protrusions, and its sharp teeth shone with a cold light, making people feel terrified.

Suddenly, the crocodile kicked its hind legs and jumped up suddenly, with its head exposed to the ground. Fortunately, its front legs got stuck on the edge of the trap and could not escape.

This startled Wang Shuo. If the crocodile rushed out at this time, it would be a big deal!

He quickly threw the high-end fishing net on the crocodile, but it failed to catch the crocodile's feet, and it quickly broke free.

Wang Shuo's face darkened, and he took the spare high-grade fishing net in his hand again. This time he must find the right opportunity to trap the crocodile's feet.

Since the trap was not wide, the crocodile could not turn around in the trap. Seeing the crocodile destroying the walls of the trap with its claws and teeth, Wang Shuo found the right opportunity and put the fishing net around the crocodile's limbs.

The crocodile was obviously panicked and kept "death rolling", but the result was that it rolled further and further and was tied tighter, and soon it was tied into a rice dumpling.

Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief!

Seeing that the crocodile had armor-like skin, he reluctantly took out his bamboo bow and shot a few arrows at it. As expected, he couldn't even tickle the crocodile.

Seeing the crocodile's disdainful eyes, Wang Shuo felt insulted.

But at this time Wang Shuo had no choice but to do this for the time being!

"Just think of it as digging a pond and raising a fish!" Wang Shuo chuckled and turned around to leave.

Returning to the shelter, he continued to enjoy his dinner. With rich supplies, he already disliked the smelly fish. He planned to exchange some other food with other players.

Open [Chat Channel].

Wang Shuo kept looking at the information, trying to find out if any players had exchanged any delicious food for supplies.

Soon, Wang Shuo found a man who exchanged bread for food, which aroused his great interest.

Find the player named Huang Feiguang with ID: 2144 and click to chat privately.

"Brother, this is amazing! There is such a thing as bread!" Wang Shuo complimented.

Huang Feiguang said with some pride: "Of course, I have a lot of good things, this is just junk food that can barely fill my stomach."

Wang Shuo looked a little unhappy and responded: "Brother, I have been eating fish for the past two days, and my mouth is filled with the smell of fish. I want to change my taste. I wonder what I want to change?"

"What can you offer?"

"How about the tiles?"

Wang Shuo chose tiles with high cost performance, which were easy for him to make, but for other players, they were not easy to obtain.

"Okay, a piece of bread for 100 tiles, no bargaining." Huang Feiguang said calmly.

Seeing the opponent's lion opening his mouth, Wang Shuo had the urge to block him directly, but unfortunately he had not discovered this function yet.

Wang Shuo took a deep breath, tried his best to maintain his demeanor, and replied unhurriedly: "Haha, I suddenly don't want to eat this kind of junk food anymore!"

After saying that, just ignore him.

But the other party still replied: "If you don't change it now, it won't be the same price later. Don't starve to death then, come and beg me."

Wang Shuo was so angry that his lungs were about to explode.

I can only keep telling myself not to be like this kind of person whose nostrils are raised to the sky.

At this moment, the system prompt sounded:

[The house upgrade is about to be completed, please leave the brick house. 】

As soon as Wang Shuo walked out of the house, the brick house in front of him turned into three tile houses.

"Not bad, not bad!" Wang Shuo sighed.

[Residential house: Durability 500/500, which can provide greater protection for your safety. If you have a three-bedroom house, you no longer have to worry about living in it. For more functions, please explore by yourself. 】

The tall eaves, red-lacquered doors, and carved windows made Wang Shuo feel full of joy.

Just when Wang Shuo was admiring his three-bedroom apartment, a drop of rain suddenly fell on his hand, and it immediately began to corrode Wang Shuo's hand, which made Wang Shuo cry out in pain.

He hurriedly ran into the house, found clean water, and cleaned the wound. Fortunately, the wound was treated in time. The skin was only slightly injured and slightly red and swollen, but there was no bleeding.

Wang Shuo looked outside the house again, and at this time, raindrops fell in big drops, splashing on the ground.

Thinking that the rainwater had a strong corrosive effect, he took one end of the wooden stick and put the other end into the rain.

It was okay at first, the wooden stick didn't change much. After 1 minute, the wooden stick started to bubble and began to corrode.

He quickly closed the door.

Opening the [Chat Channel], people kept complaining.

"Ah! My head hurts so much. When I grab my hair, it's like a handful."

"I feel like the roof of my wooden house can't withstand the rain!"

"It was acid rain. My hands were corroded."

…

"Whoa, what should I do? Who can save me?"

"There seems to be nothing wrong with my stone house. The tiles on the roof can withstand acid rain."

"Quick, whoever has tiles, I want to replace them."

Wang Shuo did not speak in the channel, but his private chat messages and reminders to add friends kept ringing.

[ID:3610 Zhang Yang, request to add you as a friend. ]

[ID:9998 Zhao Tianze, request to add you as a friend. ]

[ID:2144 Huang Feiguang, request to add you as a friend. ]

…

[ID:3839 Yue Ji, request to add you as a friend. ]

[ID:8899 Tang Hua, request to add you as a friend. ]

…

Wang Shuo agreed to Zhang Yang, who was the first to add him as a friend.

“Brother, do you have any more tiles?” Zhang Yang used the voice directly, with a somewhat urgent tone.

“Yes.”

Zhang Yang felt a little relieved. Now there must be a long line of people looking for Wang Shuo to exchange tiles. He still understood the principle of being quick and getting something.

“I have iron ore here. I’ll exchange it with you. What do you think?”

Wang Shuo was a little surprised that he had such a high-level ore as iron ore so quickly.

As expected, we should not underestimate other players. Everyone has their own adventures.

"Okay."

"I will exchange 200 iron ores for 400 tiles. What do you think?"

Wang Shuo thought about it. Although tiles are life-saving items now, the value of iron ore is not low. With a ratio of 1:2, Zhang Yang is very sincere.

Wang Shuo immediately agreed to the transaction.

[Tiles - 400, Iron Ore + 200]

Wang Shuo guessed that Zhang Yang directly exchanged for 400 tiles and should have upgraded the stone house. He probably felt insecure and wanted to upgrade the shelter to a higher level.

In fact, Wang Shuo's guess was not right. Zhang Yang not only needed to upgrade the shelter himself, but also exchanged some tiles for Wang Yuyao. After all, Wang Yuyao had sent him hot water before. He never dared to forget this favor.

Wang Shuo browsed other friend requests and private chat messages again, and selected some with higher prices, especially those that provided scarce resources, and traded them.

Wang Shuo is not a saint, he can't save everyone, the one who pays the highest price wins, it's only natural.

Inadvertently, he found that Huang Feiguang was also adding him as a friend crazily, he didn't want to pay attention to this person.

But due to his evil psychology, Wang Shuo agreed to his request.
